mapper.select: SELECT GENRE_NAME FROM GENRE WHERE GENRE_NO = #{genreNo} AND GENRE_TYPE = 'M'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
FROM WORK W
LEFT JOIN WRITER WR ON W.WRITER_NO = WR.WRITER_NO
LEFT JOIN PUBLISHER P ON W.PUB_NO = P.PUB_NO
LEFT JOIN GENRE G ON W.GENRE_NO = G.GENRE_NO
WHERE W.WORK_STATUS = 'A'
AND G.GENRE_PARENT = #{genreParentNo}
ORDER BY W.WORK_REG DESC, W.WORK_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 12

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , COUNT(PD.PD_NO) AS PURCHASE_CNT
FROM WORK W
LEFT JOIN WRITER WR ON W.WRITER_NO = WR.WRITER_NO
LEFT JOIN PUBLISHER P ON W.PUB_NO = P.PUB_NO
LEFT JOIN GENRE G ON W.GENRE_NO = G.GENRE_NO
LEFT JOIN POINT_DETAIL PD ON W.WORK_NO = PD.WORK_NO AND PD.PD_STATUS = 'P'
WHERE W.WORK_STATUS = 'A'
AND G.GENRE_PARENT = #{genreParentNo}
GROUP BY W.WORK_NO, W.WORK_TITLE, W.WORK_COVER, W.WORK_INFO, W.WORK_REG, W.WORK_LATEST, W.WORK_FAVCNT, W.PAID_YN, W.ADULT_YN, W.SERIAL_STATUS, WR.WRITER_NAME, P.PUB_NAME, G.GENRE_NAME
ORDER BY PURCHASE_CNT DESC, W.WORK_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 12
